title: Synodal Letter of Amphilochius
english: The synodal letter of Amphilochius, Bishop of Iconium.

And before receiving your letters of love, the report had reached us of your firm faith, stretched out toward dangers and enduring through sufferings for Christ, your steadfast love toward God, and the certainty of the coming hope within you. Since we have now encountered your letters of piety, we truly saw the character of an apostolic church, the zeal of good shepherds, and a restless diligence becoming true Christians. Because you did not calculate the length of the road nor lead the journeys dividedly, but made inquiry in common through the letters, you have made us very hopeful that, having written in agreement, you will receive our replies in agreement; and the unity in your letters was like a prelude to a more perfect unity. And it was our prayer to receive the wonderful and most reverently named Bishop Basil, present at the synod and a participant, and even more so to have him as a precursor in the matters concerning you. Since a sickness of the body, exceeding the arrival, hindered him, it is a perfection of your love that you did not overlook the brevity of our letters. However, we do not find your holy church lacking or that voice lacking; rather, having his own writing regarding this matter, we have with us something agreeing with him through the letter. What then is the reply regarding the journey? The holy synod of the fathers of the Council of Nicaea.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
